## Two Paths Mindset via Telegram
1. **Config**: paste the bot token (from @BotFather) and the GitHub token. Keep DRY_RUN = true for the first test.
2. Switch the workflow **Active**, then send any message to your bot: it replies *Linked*.
3. Send **/prompts** to get 2 reels now (or wait for 10:00). Make them in Flow, then **reply to each message with its video**.
4. When the test reel looks right on GitHub, set DRY_RUN = false.
Commands: /prompts, /status
